mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT d.dept_id, d.parent_dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, 1 AS depth, LPAD(CAST(d.sort_order AS VARCHAR(5)), 5, '0') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(d.dept_id AS VARCHAR(10)), 10, '0') AS sort_path FROM department d WHERE d.parent_dept_id IS NULL AND d.use_yn = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT c.dept_id, c.parent_dept_id, c.dept_name, c.dept_code, t.depth + 1, t.sort_path || '>' || LPAD(CAST(c.sort_order AS VARCHAR(5)), 5, '0') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(c.dept_id AS VARCHAR(10)), 10, '0') FROM department c JOIN dept_tree t ON c.parent_dept_id = t.dept_id WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT t.dept_id, t.parent_dept_id, t.dept_name, t.dept_code, t.depth, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e WHERE e.dept_id = t.dept_id AND e.use_yn = 'Y') AS emp_count FROM dept_tree t ORDER BY t.sort_path
